 Vox Machina Sequel The Mighty Nein Sets Season 2 Release Date for Prime Video
 Devanshi Basu 2026년 11월 16일 월 오전 4:13 UTC 0 Photo Credit: Prime Video Prime Video has confirmed a return date for its Critical Role animated adaptation, revealing when The Mighty Nein Season 2 will launch worldwide and how many episodes subscribers will get on day one. After all, fans are eagerly anticipating the Vox Machina sequel release date.
 The Mighty Nein Season 2 arrives on Prime Video next year
 The streamer announced at TwitchCon on November 15 that The Mighty Nein Season 2 will release on Prime Video on March 24, 2027. All eight episodes will drop simultaneously across more than 240 countries and territories. Liam O’Brien, who voices Caleb Widogast, unveiled the date during a live one-shot at the event. It also featured Benjamin Walker and Maxim Baldry from The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power, plus Critical Role’s Sam Riegel and Travis Willingham. O’Brien ran the game as Game Master.
 Advertisement
 The first season premiered on November 19, 2025, and holds a perfect 100% score on Rotten Tomatoes. The show adapts Critical Role’s second tabletop campaign and unfolds 20 years after The Legend of Vox Machina, though it centers on a separate group of heroes. The Mighty Nein Season 2 sends the party on a pirate voyage across the high seas. Fjord’s expanding powers pull him toward a darker path, the Beacon exposes tempting new possibilities, and the group must weigh newfound magic against their friendship.
 Amazon MGM Studios, Critical Role, Panda Burrow, and Titmouse produce the series for Prime Video. The cast features Laura Bailey, Taliesin Jaffe, Ashley Johnson, Matthew Mercer, Liam O’Brien, Marisha Ray, Sam Riegel, and Travis Willingham. Tasha Huo serves as showrunner and executive producer alongside the Critical Role founders and Titmouse’s Chris Prynoski, Antonio Canobbio, Ben Kalina, and Shannon Prynoski.
 Viewers can stream all eight episodes of The Mighty Nein Season 2 on Prime Video when it debuts on March 24, 2027.
